description: A tenant default currency change updates tenant-scoped clients whose stored currency equals the previous tenant default.
A tenant default currency change preserves client currencies that differ from the previous tenant default.
Client propagation and the tenant settings write execute in one transaction and roll back together.
Billing-settings saves that omit currency or resave the same effective currency do not update clients.
The default-billing-settings action returns previous/new currency and updated/preserved client counts after a currency save.
Billing Settings explains that matching client defaults follow a tenant currency change while distinct client currencies and existing documents/templates remain unchanged.
Billing Settings reports propagated and preserved client counts after a successful tenant currency change.
A new quote seeded with a client uses that client's default currency and identifies the client as the source.
prdRefs: Users and Primary Flows > Create a quote for a client

description: Changing or clearing the client on a new quote re-resolves the currency to the new client default or tenant default and updates the source label.
The quick-add-client quote flow applies the new client's default currency and source consistently with normal selection.
Applying a business quote template uses the template currency and identifies that template as the source.
prdRefs: Users and Primary Flows > Create a quote from a business template

description: Directly changing the quote currency picker identifies the currency as manually selected.
Editing an existing quote preserves its currency and identifies it as saved on the quote instead of applying current defaults.
Editing an existing business quote template preserves its currency and identifies it as saved on the template.
QuoteForm resolves tenant settings and clients deterministically so asynchronous loading cannot restore USD over a client or template choice.
Server-side quote creation retains explicit, client, tenant, then USD currency precedence for non-form callers.
Quote Detail formats subtotal, discount, tax, and total by converting stored minor units to major units exactly once.
All new billing-settings and quote-form source copy uses the existing i18n namespaces with English fallback text.
